report.explanation: Current telemetry does not substantiate the operator's deployment hypothesis. Traces show checkout, order, payment, inventory and postgres save_order all returning 200 with no errors. The deployment record shows only baseline order v1.0.0 with no previous version, so it cannot establish a deployment-caused fault. Metrics show order v1.0.0 serving /v1/orders 200s with zero 502s, and v2.0.0 carrying no traffic. No bounded cause is established; hand off.

Deployment record for order v2.0.0 including rollout time and previous version
